scenario.title: Clarify an ambiguous request
scenario.objective: Reach a useful next step without fabricating user needs or inflating an uncertain request into a platform.
successCriteria: The affected person and desired outcome are concrete
The smallest useful product slice is named
Deferred ideas stay outside the committed scope

agents.responsibility: Reconciles specialist outputs into one accountable decision.

trace.title: Name the person and impact
trace.action: Translate the request into a concrete user, situation, frustration, and desired change.

trace.title: Expose hidden assumptions
trace.action: Separate supplied facts from guesses, preferences, and questions that still need an owner.

trace.title: Recognize the product pattern
trace.action: Match the problem to proven product shapes without copying a larger platform by default.

trace.title: Set the decision boundaries
trace.action: Define what would be misleading, harmful, or unjustified given the available evidence.

trace.title: Shape the smallest complete journey
trace.action: Order onboarding, core action, output, failure handling, and the next user decision.

trace.title: Reconcile scope and tradeoffs
trace.action: Compose one direction and preserve meaningful dissent as explicit acceptance risks.

trace.title: Transform direction into a test
trace.action: Define a reversible implementation slice and the evidence that would justify expansion.

trace.title: Preserve the learning boundary
trace.action: Record chosen scope, deferred ideas, and the conditions that would reopen the decision.
